summary: Wave 11 — LATAM Public Data Connector Framework. Backend-only testing. Created /app/backend/tests/test_wave11_connectors.py (15 tests, all passing). Full regression 58/58 pass across wave6_auth_email + wave7_growth + wave8a_ecosystem + discovery + sources_center + growth. Verified: (a) PublicDataConnector base — bare stub with requires_credentials=True + env_keys=('X',) → is_configured()==False, health()['configured']==False, sync(db) returns {'skipped':'missing_credentials','ingested':0,'updated':0}; (b) Registry has 42 connectors covering all 18 required countries {AR,BO,BR,CL,CO,CR,DO,EC,ES,GT,HN,MX,PA,PE,PY,SV,UY} + GLOBAL; (c) 26 prepared credential stubs including every one in the spec (br-openfinance, co-secop/rues/spe, mx-denue, ar-saij, cl-chilecompra, pe-sunat/sunarp, ec-sri/sercop, pa-panamacompra, uy-dgi, cr-sicop, do-dgii, gt-guatecompras, hn-honducompras, bo-seprec, py-dncp, es-sepe, global-mercadolibre/shopify/belvo/prometeo) and ALL stubs return {'skipped':'missing_credentials'} on sync without crashing; (d) CKANConnector.normalize() emits growth_item with id starting 'ck_', country=CO, kind='public_dataset', vertical='instituciones', title, summary, url, tags[]; validate()==True; (e) Circuit breaker — setting _fail_streak=6 and _last_sync_at=now on an operational connector causes sync(db) to return {'skipped':'circuit_breaker'} with no DB writes (verified with a FakeDB that would raise on update_one); (f) GET /api/growth/connectors returns {total:42, connectors:[...], by_country:[...18 rows]} — every item exposes id/name/country/kind/configured/last_sync_status/last_error/last_ingested/ttl_seconds/next_run_in_seconds; by_country aggregates operational/pending/requires_credentials/error/total; (g) At least 8 connectors report last_sync_status=='ok' (spec requires >=3); (h) MongoDB growth_items.count_documents({kind:'public_dataset'}) >= 100 with each doc carrying country and source_id; (i) POST /api/growth/connectors/pa-datosabiertos/sync returns 200 with {ok,ingested,updated,elapsed_ms} for admin JWT and 401/403 for anonymous — unknown connector id returns 404; (j) Regression: GET /api/discovery/entity/microsoft/related?country=CO and GET /api/discovery/trending?scope=country&country=CO both return 200 with Wave 9 payload shape preserved; (k) Backend supervisor log contains 'connectors tick ran=' entry, confirming scheduler integration is active. Expected preview-only errors: MX/EC/CR/BO/PY CKAN portals fail with SSL_CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED from the dev preview container (documented as expected in review request) — not a bug.

minor.endpoint: CKAN sync (mx-datosgob, ec-datosabiertos, cr-datosabiertos, bo-datosgob, py-datosgov)
minor.issue: SSL_CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED from preview datacenter — expected per review note; framework handles gracefully via fail_streak / circuit breaker. AR/CL/PE/UY/DO/PA CKAN connectors reach 'ok' state and ingest datasets.

critical_code_review_comments: PublicDataConnector.sync() short-circuits cleanly on both missing_credentials and circuit_breaker without touching the DB. Fail streak resets on ok — correct.
run_all_due() is sequential with a 45s per-connector timeout; timeout increments _fail_streak. Good rate-limiting behavior for outbound.
CKANConnector uses hashlib.sha1(f'{self.id}::{cid}') as doc id — deterministic + upsert-friendly; validate() checks id+title which is sufficient.

registry.get() memoizes to a module-level _REGISTRY. Since connectors carry mutable state (fail_streak, _last_sync_at), refresh() must be called explicitly if code re-seeds — worth flagging in tests that mutate state (I reset _fail_streak / _last_sync_at after the circuit-breaker test to avoid poisoning subsequent runs).
Endpoint /api/growth/connectors is unauthenticated and exposes env_keys names only (never values) + last_error strings truncated to 220 chars — safe.
POST /api/growth/connectors/{id}/sync correctly gated by require_admin; unknown id returns 404. Good.
Scheduler _process_connectors is wrapped in try/except and logs on failure — ensures a connector import/crash never blocks the RSS pipeline.

Nit: 5 of the 11 CKAN portals will consistently fail on the preview container (SSL) — consider adding verify_ssl=False as a per-portal opt-in in a future wave, or an httpx AsyncClient with a bundled CA. Not a bug for this wave per the review note.
Nit: registry.build_registry() hardcodes 42 connectors inline — file is ~180 lines, still readable, no refactor needed.
seed_data_creation: None. Public datasets were auto-ingested by the scheduler on backend startup (CKAN portals for AR/CL/PE/UY/DO/PA yielded >100 growth_items with kind=public_dataset).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 11 framework is stable. Reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_wave11_connectors.py (15 tests, ~100s runtime dominated by test_public_dataset_count which polls up to 90s for scheduler catch-up and test_at_least_three_ok which polls up to 60s). If iterating: (1) circuit-breaker test mutates a live registry instance — remember to reset _fail_streak/_last_sync_at at end; (2) preview container cannot reach MX/EC/CR/BO/PY CKAN portals over SSL — do not treat as regression; (3) POST /api/growth/connectors/{id}/sync uses Bearer JWT (auth.require_admin), not community cookie.
